why: wiki/canary-watch.md: the 10Y-3M curve stands at +106bp and the bear-flattening streak paused on a parallel bear shift, which is the shape that pays bank NIM.
wiki/financials.md: money centers closed green in a red tape (C +0.80%, WFC +0.36%, BAC +0.02%) while XLF 57.25 held its 50D at 57.11.
wiki/economic-calendar.md: a Sep 16 hike at roughly 87-90% odds is a NIM tailwind that is already largely priced.
risks: A dovish surprise on Sep 16, or a re-inversion of the 10Y-3M spread from +106bp, removes the NIM thesis.
Credit is the tell: HYG 78.60 and LQD 104.32 have both posted two straight red weeks.
